title: Nanit Breathing-Motion Gap Alert
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nanit:sleep
| search breathing_status=tracked
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by child_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| sort - hours_since
description: Shows which childrens have gone quiet for Nanit breathing-motion captures.
value: A long gap in tracked breathing-motion events is a simple cue that the sensor, placement, or export workflow needs checking.
implementation: Send Nanit breathing-motion captures events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of childrens with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It measures which childrens have gone quiet longer than they should for Nanit breathing-motion captures.
